need: Implement a portable typed CLI and library for evidence records, filtering, local state, and GitHub read adapters.

discovery.stop_condition: One mature contender per relevant ecosystem plus the language already selected by the approved implementation contract.

contenders.name: Python 3.12+
evidence: typed JSON and CLI ecosystem match the release

contenders.name: Go with Cobra
evidence: no single-binary or Go-native service requirement

contenders.name: Rust with clap
evidence: no systems-performance or Rust integration requirement

contenders.name: TypeScript with Commander
evidence: no Node-native runtime or UI requirement

unknowns: Future requirements may introduce a justified single-binary distribution need.
decision_effect: Use Python >=3.12,<3.15 with PEP 621, src layout, py.typed, uv, and Hatchling.
reconsider_when: A measured install/distribution barrier requires a single binary
